keySentence: She cared for the garden every day.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The garden was coming alive. New buds appeared on branches. Mary was changing too. She cared for the garden every day.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The secret garden was slowly waking up from its long sleep. New green buds appeared on the old brown branches. She cared for the garden every day with love and patience. Mary was changing too, becoming kinder and happier each day. She had been a grumpy, lonely girl when she first arrived. Now she smiled and laughed while working in the warm sunshine.
